title: Roblins
description: Craig, lord of the Warren, wants shiny things and his Cut every fourth day. Fly Mortimer's Gutbucket to a tomb each night, creep past what guards it by lantern light, and haul the loot home before dawn — or it's the pit. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 goblins.
